GLOBAL STARTER-SLOT RULE: unless a definition expressly requires otherwise, count only players or defenses occupying active starter slots. Exclude bench, IR, taxi and all other non-starting rostered assets. Flex and Superflex count by the actual player occupying the starting slot. Count each starter once. Carried on every row as starter_slot_rule.
GRAMMAR: the closed SUM/RATIO grammar is preserved unchanged. Formulas outside it carry a distinct governed evaluator_shape and are not expressible as metric_expression strings.

TOUCHDOWN SEMANTICS: total_touchdown_credits counts fantasy touchdown credits, not unique NFL scoring plays. A QB-to-receiver touchdown between two active starters yields two credits. Owner ruling Q-VOCAB-1, intentional.

CATALOG COMPLETENESS PRINCIPLE (binding): every Pool definition must be complete and deterministic at the product level. Commissioner configuration may enable or disable a governed definition, but may not supply a missing formula, threshold, data meaning, scoring interpretation, winner rule or settlement behavior. A definition requiring commissioner interpretation to become mathematically complete is not eligible for the active catalog: it must be completed by owner ruling or retired under zero-based budgeting.

RETIRED under that principle: #8, #9, #10, #11, #12 carried unbound threshold_value predicates. Numbers preserved permanently, never reused, not replaced in this revision. #89, #90, #91 and #94 are NOT retired: they carry explicit governed thresholds (10, 500, 700, 100) and require no commissioner interpretation.

TWO GATES, distinct. GATE 1 definition_runtime_eligible is PERSISTENT definition metadata: product-ENABLED, required_stats resolved, every required stat authoritatively source-mapped, and product_complete (mathematically complete without commissioner interpretation). GATE 2 league_activation_ready is TRANSIENT environment state keyed by league, provider and definition or required-source set, carrying a measurement timestamp. IT IS NOT STORED ON A DEFINITION and does not appear in the definitions array. The selector requires BOTH. GATE-1 COUNT IS A CEILING, NOT A FORECAST: 64 is the current Gate-1 ceiling. Restoring provider access clears one Gate-2 precondition only and does not by itself return any definition to selectable status. The selectable count must be recomputed after every Gate-2 requirement is satisfied for the particular league, provider and definition or required-source set. It is never stated in advance. See current_environment for the dated snapshot; the Gate-2 persistence carrier is implementation scope.

KICKER SCORING BASIS (owner ruling 2026-08-01, binding). #18 Highest Scoring Kicker and #77 Highest Scoring Kicker Matchup both settle on actual Yahoo fantasy football points scored under the league's governing Yahoo scoring settings, via the canonical operand kicking_points. #18 compares the active starting kicker of each TEAM subject. #77 sums the actual Yahoo fantasy points of the two active starting kickers in each scheduled MATCHUP subject. Neither is computed from raw field-goal counts, field-goal distance, or any 3xFG + 1xXP reconstruction. The persisted keys most_kicking_points and highest_combined_kicker_points are unchanged; a key is an immutable identifier and does not track a display name.

TIE PAYOUT REMAINDER (owner ruling 2026-08-01, binding). tie_rule EVEN_SPLIT is fully specified and carries no implementation discretion. base_share_cents = floor(pot_cents / winner_count). remainder_count = pot_cents % winner_count. Every winner receives base_share_cents. The first remainder_count winners, ordered by canonical GM identifier ascending, each receive one additional cent. The ordering key is the stable canonical GM identifier, never a display name, roster position, claim order, or database-return order. The full pot is conserved and distributed exactly once. Ties settle and never roll. A retry must reproduce the identical allocation. Governed at POR §6.3.

SETTLEMENT IDEMPOTENCY (binding on any future implementation). Every economic settlement or sweep generated by a pool instance must post its ledger entries and transition pool_instance.settled inside one atomic database transaction, and must carry an event-keyed idempotency key protected by a database uniqueness constraint. A row lock may supplement that protocol but never replaces it. Governed at POR §6.4 and Scope §G1.

definitions.governed_definition: Highest individual passing_yards + rushing_yards among active starters in QB-eligible slots. In multi-QB or Superflex leagues, evaluate all active QB-eligible starters and use the highest individual total. Bench quarterbacks do not count.
Sum actual fantasy points scored by active starters at QB, RB, WR, TE, Flex, Superflex and K. Exclude D/ST. Highest total wins. Exact ties split evenly.

raw_run_points = actual fantasy points from active starting RBs. raw_pass_game_points = actual fantasy points from active starting WRs and TEs. run_points = max(0, raw_run_points). pass_game_points = max(0, raw_pass_game_points). If run_points == 0 and pass_game_points == 0 then balance_score = 0; otherwise balance_score = min(run_points, pass_game_points) / max(run_points, pass_game_points). Highest balance_score wins. Flex and Superflex players follow actual player position. Exclude QB, K and D/ST. Both components zero is a defined score of zero, NOT unevaluable.
Count distinct touchdown categories recorded by the team's active starters, including D/ST. Each category counts at most once. Highest distinct-category count wins. Exact ties split evenly.
definitions.blocked_reason: Yahoo's documented touchdown-category granularity cannot represent the approved category list. Stat 49 collapses kickoff and punt return touchdowns into one counter. Stat 35 collapses D/ST touchdown types. Stat 15 is a single offensive return-TD counter. No blocked-kick-return touchdown category is exposed. The Pool concept is approved and unchanged; only source support is missing.
